messages:
Rhea M (Finance): Spectral invoice INV-77012 hit Coupa but is on HOLD - approver not found. Can someone check?
Carlos V (Purchasing): Pulling it up. Looks like vendor sent PO on PDF (PO-4201) but EDI PO field blank. Vendor id in feed is SPECT-OLD, we expect SPECTRAL-CO.
FinanceBot: Auto-hold applied: missing_po_field; vendor_id_mismatch.
Spectral AP: Sorry, our billing system used old tenant. We can re-send EDI with vendor id SPECTRAL-CO and PO field populated tonight. PDF link: https://files.spectral.example/INV-77012.pdf (PO-4201 on p1).
Rhea M (Finance): Two routes: wait for corrected EDI or do manual match now. Manual match will need an invoice note and a GL tag.
Carlos V (Purchasing): If amounts and qtys match, approve manually. Confirm cost center: PO maps to CC-210. If mismatch, we dispute.
Rhea M (Finance): Please do manual match, tag note "manual_match_vendor_migration", route to @Carlos V for approval, and then finalize payment. If Spectral re-sends EDI later, we'll record reconciliation.
FinanceBot: Action logged: manual PO match by Rhea M. Status -> Pending Approver.
Carlos V (Purchasing): Approved. Verified lines vs PO-4201. Routing for payment.
Spectral AP: Thanks, we'll push corrected EDI and confirm. Apologies for the noise.
Rhea M (Finance): Thanks everyone. Closing after payment run completes.
